topic: AIVim: a Vim AI editor running on Ollama
title: AIVim: Your Ollama Becomes the Editor
description: Working description, replaced by stage 05. AIVim wired to a local Ollama server.
hook_text: Vim-style AI editor, on your model
hook_candidates: Your Ollama models are already running. This editor finally uses them.
A Vim-style AI editor just shipped, and it runs on the model you already have.
One URL, and your Ollama model edits code with you.
Three moves tonight: a Vim editor that thinks with your model.
Zero stars. One maintainer. Your editor still runs local AI tonight.
Vim keys, local model, no cloud account. AIVim just shipped.
Your editor's AI brain is already installed. It's called Ollama.
Fifty kilobytes of context, and the model never leaves your machine.
localhost 11434 is the only account this AI editor needs.
Stop pasting code into a chat tab. Edit with the model instead.
narration_full: AIVim just shipped: a Vim-style editor running your Ollama model. Yesterday its author posted AIVim, a Vim-style terminal editor, to Hacker News. Your Ollama becomes the brain of a real editor, not a chat tab. It wants Python three point nine or newer. It speaks the OpenAI-compatible plug, the one every AI tool uses. Ollama serves that plug at localhost, port eleven four three four. The catch: a Vim subset, so your plugins stay home. And it is days old. One person's project, unproven. Tonight, pipx install aivim and aim it at your Ollama. Then try one live block: plain English in, and code streams back while you keep typing.
